parts.name: Part 1
parts.dir: 사진을 보고 한 사람이 읽어 주는 네 개의 문장을 들은 뒤, 사진을 가장 잘 묘사한 것을 고르세요. 문장은 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않으며 한 번만 들려줍니다.

say.t: (C) She's pouring coffee into a cup.

items.ex: 창가 책상에서 노트북을 사용하는 여자의 모습이므로 (B)가 정답. 커피잔이 보인다고 (C)처럼 '따르는 중'이라는 동작을 고르면 함정.

say.t: (A) A man is writing on a whiteboard.
(B) Some people are leaving the room.
(C) The chairs are stacked in a corner.
(D) A woman is standing in front of a screen.

items.ex: 여자가 대형 화면 앞에 서서 발표하고 있으므로 (D)가 정답. 사람들은 앉아 있으니 방을 나가는 중이라는 (B)는 오답.

say.t: (B) People are sitting in a circle.
(C) Some chairs are lined up along the walls.
(D) Some pictures are being taken down.

items.ex: 사람 없는 강의실에 의자들이 양쪽 벽을 따라 줄지어 있으므로 (C)가 정답. 사람이 없는데 'is being + p.p.'(진행 중인 동작)를 쓴 (A)·(D)는 함정.

say.t: (A) Some people are closing their books.
(B) A man is erasing a whiteboard.
(C) A man is standing in an aisle.

items.ex: 사람들이 책을 펴고 앉아 있고 남자 한 명이 통로에 서 있으므로 (C)가 정답. 책을 '덮고 있다'는 (A)는 반대 동작 함정.

say.t: (A) Some plants have been placed on a shelf.
(B) Some flowers are being planted outside.
(C) A woman is watering some plants.
(D) A display case is being moved.

items.ex: 선반 위에 화분들이 놓여 있으므로 (A)가 정답. 사진에 사람이 없는데 물을 주는 사람을 묘사한 (C)는 오답.

say.t: (A) Some people are sitting around a table.
(B) A man is putting books on a shelf.
(C) They're standing in line at a counter.

items.ex: 남녀 여러 명이 테이블에 둘러앉아 대화하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답. 뒤에 책장이 보인다고 책을 꽂는 동작 (B)를 고르면 함정.

parts.name: Part 2
parts.dir: 질문 또는 진술 하나와 세 개의 응답을 듣고 가장 알맞은 응답을 고르세요. 질문과 응답은 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않으며 한 번만 들려줍니다.

say.t: (C) It's next to the reception desk.

items.ex: Where(장소) 질문에 위치로 답한 (C)가 정답. print-printed 비슷한 발음 함정 (B), 의문사 질문에 Yes로 답한 (A)는 오답.

say.t: When does the training session start?

items.ex: When(시간) 질문에 시각으로 답한 (B)가 정답. (C)는 Where에 대한 답.

say.t: Who's going to lead the client meeting?

items.ex: Who(사람) 질문에 사람 이름으로 답한 (C)가 정답. meeting-met 연상 함정 (B)는 오답.

say.t: Would you like me to book a meeting room online?

items.ex: 제안(Would you like me to ~?)을 받아들인 (A)가 정답. book(예약하다)을 '책'으로 바꾼 (B)는 다의어 함정.

say.t: (A) Because of a storm near the port.

items.ex: Why(이유) 질문에 Because로 이유를 말한 (A)가 정답. shipment-shipped 반복 단어 함정 (C)는 오답.

say.t: How do I charge my electric car here?
(A) Yes, I'm in charge of the project.
(B) Just scan the QR code on the charger.

items.ex: How(방법) 질문에 충전 방법을 알려 준 (B)가 정답. charge를 '담당'으로 바꾼 (A)는 다의어 함정.

say.t: Are you working from home tomorrow?
(C) No, I'll be in the office.

items.ex: 재택 여부를 묻는 질문에 No + 사무실에 있겠다고 답한 (C)가 정답. (A)는 Yes 뒤에 주어(he)가 맞지 않는 함정.

say.t: Haven't you signed up for the new software course?
(A) Not yet, but I'll do it today.

items.ex: 부정의문문은 일반의문문처럼 해석: 등록했는지 묻는 말에 '아직 안 했다'고 답한 (A)가 정답. sign 반복 함정 (B)는 오답.

say.t: Which bus goes to the convention center?

items.ex: Which bus(어느 버스) 질문에 버스 번호로 답한 (A)가 정답. (C)는 How long에 어울리는 답.

say.t: Let's order lunch for the team.
(B) Good idea. What should we get?

items.ex: 제안에 동의하며 메뉴를 되물은 (B)가 정답. order를 '순서'로 바꾼 (A)는 다의어 함정.

say.t: How long will the renovation take?

items.ex: How long(기간) 질문에 기간으로 답한 (B)가 정답. long 반복 함정 (C)는 오답.

say.t: Could you send me the sales report?
(A) Sure, I'll e-mail it right away.

items.ex: 요청(Could you ~?)을 수락한 (A)가 정답. sales·report 단어만 반복한 (B)·(C)는 오답.

say.t: The client wants to change the meeting time.
(A) What time works better for them?
(B) I need to change my clothes.

items.ex: 평서문에 되묻기로 자연스럽게 반응한 (A)가 정답. change 반복 함정 (B)는 오답.

say.t: Should we use the AI tool or write the summaries ourselves?
(C) Let's try the AI tool first.

items.ex: 선택의문문에 둘 중 하나(AI 도구)를 고른 (C)가 정답. 선택의문문에 Yes로 답한 (A)는 오답.

say.t: Isn't the café closed on Mondays?

items.ex: 월요일 휴무인지 묻자 '이제 매일 연다'고 정정한 (B)가 정답. closed-close 반복 함정 (C)는 오답.

say.t: Where can I find the parking permit form?
(C) Hannah in HR has some copies.

items.ex: 장소를 직접 말하진 않지만 '인사팀 Hannah에게 있다'고 간접적으로 알려 준 (C)가 정답. parking-parked 함정 (B)는 오답.

say.t: What did you think of the new subscription plan?
(A) On the first of every month.
(B) It's cheaper than the old one.

items.ex: 의견을 묻는 질문에 '이전보다 저렴하다'고 평가한 (B)가 정답. subscription-subscribe 함정 (C)는 오답.

say.t: Do you know when the delivery truck will arrive?
(C) The tracking app says around noon.

items.ex: 간접의문문의 핵심은 when(시간): 앱 기준 정오쯤이라고 답한 (C)가 정답. Do you know에 Yes로만 반응한 (B)는 내용이 맞지 않음.

say.t: Why don't we take the train to the conference?

items.ex: Why don't we ~?는 이유가 아니라 '제안'이므로 동의한 (B)가 정답. Why만 듣고 Because를 고른 (C)는 대표 함정.

say.t: Who approved the budget for the website?

items.ex: Who(사람) 질문에 직책으로 답한 (B)가 정답. budget에서 금액을 연상한 (C)는 함정.

say.t: I can't log in to the video call.
(B) I'd like to watch the video.

items.ex: 로그인 문제를 말하자 해결책을 제시한 (A)가 정답. call·video 반복 함정 (C)·(B)는 오답.

say.t: Is the staff meeting on Thursday or Friday?
(A) It's been moved to next week.

items.ex: 선택의문문에 둘 다 아닌 제3의 답(다음 주로 연기)을 한 (A)가 정답. 선택의문문에 Yes로 답한 (B)는 오답.

say.t: How many people signed up for the workshop?

items.ex: How many(수) 질문에 숫자로 답한 (C)가 정답. signed 반복 함정 (B)는 오답.

say.t: You've already registered for the hybrid work seminar, right?
(B) Yes, I did it online yesterday.

items.ex: 확인 질문(~, right?)에 Yes + 등록 방법을 덧붙인 (B)가 정답. work-works 함정 (A)는 오답.

say.t: Would you rather meet in person or online?

items.ex: 선택의문문에 온라인을 고른 (C)가 정답. person-personal 비슷한 발음 함정 (B)는 오답.

parts.name: Part 3
parts.dir: 두 사람 또는 세 사람의 대화를 듣고, 화면에 제시된 대화별 질문 세 개에 대해 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 대화는 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않으며 한 번만 들려줍니다.

script.t: Hi, I booked Meeting Room B through your app for two o'clock, but there's already a group using it.
Oh, I'm sorry about that. Let me check the system... It looks like the app made a double booking this morning.
I see. Well, I have a client arriving in ten minutes, so I really need a quiet place to talk.
Room D is free all afternoon, and it's actually a little bigger. You can use it at no extra cost.
That's perfect. Can I connect my laptop to the screen in there?
Yes, there's a cable on the table. I'll also send a new QR code to your phone so you can unlock the door.

qs.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
qs.ex: 앱으로 회의실을 예약하고 다른 회의실로 안내받는 상황이므로 공유 오피스(C)가 정답. laptop·screen만 듣고 전자제품 매장 (B)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What problem does the woman mention?
o: A room she reserved is being used.
Her client has canceled a meeting.
qs.ex: 예약한 Room B를 다른 그룹이 쓰고 있다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. double booking(중복 예약)을 '이중 결제'로 오해한 (C)는 함정.

qs.q: What will the man send to the woman?
o: A code to open a door
qs.ex: 문을 열 수 있는 새 QR 코드를 휴대폰으로 보내 주겠다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 케이블은 이미 테이블 위에 있다고 했으므로 (C)는 오답.

script.t: Good evening, Lakeview Hotel front desk. How can I help you?
Hi, I'm staying in room 412. I drove here in an electric car, and I was wondering if you have charging stations.
We do. There are six chargers on the first level of our parking garage.
Great. Do I need to pay to use them?
They're free for hotel guests. You just need a charging card, which you can pick up here at the front desk.
OK, I'll come down after dinner. Oh, and what time is breakfast served tomorrow?
From six thirty to ten, in the restaurant on the second floor.

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
o: To ask about charging her car
To reserve a table for dinner
qs.ex: 전기차 충전소가 있는지 물어보려고 전화했으므로 (A)가 정답. dinner가 들린다고 저녁 예약 (D)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the man say the woman needs to get?
qs.ex: 충전하려면 프런트에서 charging card를 받아야 한다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 주차장(parking garage)에서 연상한 (A)는 오답.

qs.q: Where is breakfast served?
qs.ex: 조식은 2층 레스토랑에서 제공된다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. first level은 충전기가 있는 주차장 층이라 (C)는 함정.

script.t: Kevin, have you tried the new AI tool that writes meeting summaries? The IT team installed it on everyone's computer yesterday.
Yes, I used it after this morning's sales meeting. It made a summary in about thirty seconds.
Really? I'm worried it might miss important details, though.
Well, I checked it against my own notes, and it got everything.
Wow. Then maybe I'll try it for the budget meeting this afternoon.
Good idea. Just remember to turn on the recording function before the meeting starts. Otherwise, it won't work.

qs.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
qs.ex: 회의 요약을 써 주는 새 AI 도구에 대한 대화이므로 (D)가 정답. sales meeting이 들린다고 (A)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Why does the man say, "I checked it against my own notes, and it got everything"?
o: To ask for the woman's notes
To explain why he was late
To show that the tool is accurate
qs.ex: 여자가 중요한 내용을 놓칠까 걱정하자, 자기 메모와 비교해 보니 다 들어 있었다며 정확하다고 안심시키는 말이므로 (C)가 정답. notes만 듣고 (A)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the man remind the woman to do?
qs.ex: 회의 시작 전에 녹음 기능을 켜라고 상기시켰으므로 (D)가 정답. IT팀은 설치 이야기에서만 나오므로 (C)는 오답.

script.t: Olivia, Raj, thanks for coming. As you know, a lot of our customers have asked us to stop using plastic in our packaging.
Right. I found a supplier that makes boxes and padding from recycled paper. Their prices are only a little higher than what we pay now.
That sounds good. But will paper padding protect fragile items, like our glass vases?
The supplier says it will. They offered to send us some free samples next week so we can test them.
Great. Raj, when the samples arrive, could you pack a few vases and ship them to our other warehouse? Then we'll see if they arrive safely.
Sure, I can do that.

qs.q: What have customers asked the business to do?
qs.ex: 고객들이 포장에 플라스틱을 그만 쓰라고 요청했으므로 (A)가 정답. glass vases가 들린다고 (B)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the woman say the supplier will do?
qs.ex: 공급업체가 다음 주에 무료 샘플을 보내 주겠다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 가격이 '조금 더 비싸다'고 했으니 할인 (D)는 오답.

qs.q: What is Raj asked to do?
o: Test the packaging by shipping some items
qs.ex: 샘플로 꽃병을 포장해 다른 창고로 보내 보라고 했으므로 포장재 테스트인 (D)가 정답. 공급업체 연락은 요청받지 않았으므로 (A)는 오답.

script.t: Thank you for calling Pantry Lane Meals. This is Daniel speaking.
Hi, I have a weekly subscription with you, but I'm going on a business trip for two weeks. I don't want any deliveries while I'm away.
No problem. Instead of canceling, you can just pause your subscription. Could I have your account number?
Thanks. OK, I've paused your deliveries starting this Friday. They'll restart automatically on the twenty-third.
Great. And can I change the menu for that first box when I get back?
Of course. You can choose your meals in our mobile app up to three days before the delivery.

qs.q: What kind of business does the man work for?
qs.ex: 주간 식사 구독 배송을 다루는 회사이므로 (D)가 정답. business trip이 들린다고 여행사 (A)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Why does the woman want to stop her deliveries?
o: She did not like the food.
She will be traveling for work.
She is moving to a new home.
qs.ex: 2주 동안 출장을 간다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 음식이 마음에 안 들었다는 말은 없으므로 (A)는 오답.

qs.q: According to the man, what can the woman do in the mobile app?
qs.ex: 모바일 앱에서 배송 3일 전까지 메뉴를 고를 수 있다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 앱 하면 떠오르는 배송 추적 (B)는 대화에 없음.

script.t: Hi, Grace. I'm trying to reserve a desk for Wednesday on the booking app, but the second floor is completely full.
Yeah, a lot of people come in on Wednesdays because of the team meetings.
I really need to be in the office that day. I'm meeting with the designers in the afternoon.
The third floor is pretty quiet these days.
Oh, I didn't know we could book desks up there.
We can, since last month. The marketing team moved to a different building, so those desks are open to everyone now. Just select "Floor 3" at the top of the app.

qs.q: What is the man trying to do?
qs.ex: 예약 앱으로 수요일 자리를 예약하려 하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답. 이미 앱을 쓰는 중이므로 앱 다운로드 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: Why does the woman say, "The third floor is pretty quiet these days"?
o: To complain about a noisy office
To suggest a place where desks may be available
To explain why a meeting was canceled
qs.ex: 2층이 꽉 찼다는 말에 '3층은 요즘 한산하다'고 한 것은 그곳에 빈자리가 있다는 제안이므로 (B)가 정답. quiet를 소음 불평으로 오해한 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: According to the woman, what happened last month?
o: A team moved to another building.
qs.ex: 지난달 마케팅팀이 다른 건물로 이사했다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. designers는 남자의 약속 상대일 뿐이므로 (D)는 오답.

script.t: Hello, this is Emma Clarke from Brightline Design. I'm calling about your interview for the graphic designer position.
Oh, hello. It's scheduled for Thursday morning, right?
That's right, but our manager has to travel that day. Would it be possible to move the interview to Friday at eleven?
Friday at eleven is fine with me.
Thank you. Also, the interview will be online instead of at our office. I'll e-mail you a link for the video call.
Sounds good. Should I prepare anything?
Yes, please be ready to share a few examples of your recent work on your screen.

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
o: To change the time of an interview
To offer the man a job
qs.ex: 목요일 면접을 금요일 11시로 옮기려고 전화했으므로 (A)가 정답. 면접 전이므로 채용 제안 (C)는 오답.

qs.q: What will the woman send the man?
o: A link for a video call
qs.ex: 화상 통화 링크를 이메일로 보내겠다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 사무실이 아닌 온라인 면접이므로 약도 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: What should the man prepare?
qs.ex: 최근 작업물 몇 개를 화면으로 보여 줄 준비를 하라고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. travel은 매니저의 출장 이야기라 (D)는 오답.

script.t: So, how is the new QR code ordering system working out?
Customers seem to like it. They can scan the code at their table and order without waiting for a server.
It's helped the kitchen, too. Orders come in faster, and there are fewer mistakes.
That's great to hear. Have there been any problems?
Some older customers find it confusing. Yesterday I had to help three tables place their orders.
Maybe we could put simple instructions on each table, with pictures.
Good idea. Sophie, could you design those instruction cards this week?
Sure. I'll have a draft ready by Thursday.

qs.q: Where do the speakers most likely work?
qs.ex: 테이블에서 QR로 주문하고 주방·서버가 등장하므로 식당(A)이 정답. 안내 카드를 만든다는 말에서 인쇄소 (C)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: According to one of the women, what problem have some customers had?
o: They find the new system difficult to use.
qs.ex: 일부 고객이 시스템을 헷갈려 한다(confusing)고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 주문이 오히려 빨라졌다고 했으므로 (A)는 오답.

qs.q: What will Sophie do this week?
qs.ex: Sophie에게 이번 주에 안내 카드를 디자인해 달라고 했고 목요일까지 초안을 준다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. server만 듣고 (C)를 고르면 함정.

script.t: Excuse me, I bought tickets online for the photography exhibition, but the scanner at the entrance won't read my QR code.
Let me take a look. Hmm... these tickets are for next Saturday, not today.
Oh no. I must have picked the wrong date. Is there any way I can still get in today?
Today's time slots are almost full, but there are two spaces left at three o'clock. I can switch your tickets to that time for free.
That would be great. It's only one fifteen now, though. What should I do until then?
Our café on the top floor has a nice view of the river. You could relax there for a while.

qs.q: What problem does the man have?
o: His tickets are for a different day.
qs.ex: 티켓이 오늘이 아니라 다음 주 토요일 것이었으므로 (A)가 정답. QR 코드가 안 읽힌다는 말만 듣고 휴대폰 분실 (D)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What time will the man enter the exhibition?
qs.ex: 3시에 두 자리가 남아 있어 그 시간으로 바꿔 주었으므로 (C)가 정답. 1시 15분은 지금 시각이므로 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: What does the woman suggest the man do?
qs.ex: 꼭대기 층 카페에서 쉬라고 제안했으므로 (B)가 정답. 원래 티켓 날짜인 토요일에 다시 오라는 말은 없으므로 (D)는 오답.

script.t: Hi, I'm calling from Westbrook Dental Clinic. We ordered five hundred business cards from your shop last week. Have they been printed yet?
Let me check... Yes, they're ready. Our delivery van can bring them to you tomorrow afternoon.
Actually, a new dentist is starting with us tomorrow morning, and she needs her cards for a conference. Could I pick them up today instead?
Sure. We're open until seven tonight.
Great. I'll stop by on my way home. Oh, and do you accept mobile payments?
We do. You can pay with any payment app when you get here.

qs.q: What did the woman order?
qs.ex: 명함 500장을 주문했다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 치과에서 전화했다는 말에서 치과 장비 (B)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Why does the woman want to get her order today?
o: She found an error in the order.
A new employee needs it soon.
qs.ex: 내일 아침 새 치과의사가 와서 학회에 명함이 필요하다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 배송 차량 고장 이야기는 없으므로 (B)는 오답.

qs.q: What does the man say about payment?
o: The order has already been paid for.
Payment must be made online in advance.
qs.ex: 어떤 결제 앱으로도 가게에서 결제할 수 있다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 미리 온라인 결제해야 한다는 (D)는 반대 내용.

script.t: Linda, our cloud storage is almost full again. We keep getting warning messages.
I know. Since we started saving all our video files online, we've been running out of space fast.
We're on the Standard plan right now. I think we should upgrade.
I agree, but the Business plan is too expensive for a team our size. Let's just go with the next plan up from the one we have now.
OK. I'll make the change today. Oh, and the website says that if we pay for a full year at once, we get two months free.
Then let's do that. And could you send a message to the team so everyone knows?

qs.q: What problem does the man mention?
o: They are running out of storage space.
qs.ex: 클라우드 저장 공간이 거의 다 찼다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. warning messages를 듣고 파일 삭제 (C)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the company pay per month for its new plan?
qs.ex: 지금 Standard를 쓰고 있고 '바로 위 단계'로 올리기로 했으므로 Plus, 월 $12인 (B)가 정답. $8은 현재 요금제라 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
o: Inform the team about a change
qs.ex: 팀원들이 알 수 있게 메시지를 보내 달라고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 비디오 파일 이야기는 원인 설명이었을 뿐이라 (D)는 오답.

script.t: Excuse me, I'm trying to get to City Hall for a ten o'clock meeting. Is this the right place to wait?
Yes, but the board says the City Hall bus is delayed. It might not come for another thirty minutes.
Oh, no. I can't be late. Is there another way to get there?
The bus to Harbor Station stops on Elm Street. That's just a five-minute walk from City Hall.
That's perfect. I'll take that one. Do I need to buy a ticket before I get on?
No. You can just tap your phone or a credit card on the reader when you board.

qs.q: Why is the woman in a hurry?
o: A store is about to close.
She has a meeting at ten o'clock.
She is meeting a friend for breakfast.
qs.ex: 10시 회의 때문에 시청에 가야 한다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. Harbor Station에서 공항·비행기를 연상한 (D)는 함정.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What time will the woman's bus leave?
qs.ex: 지연된 시청행 대신 Harbor Station행 버스를 타기로 했으므로 9시 10분인 (A)가 정답. 9:20은 지연된 시청행 버스라 (B)는 함정.

qs.q: What does the man say about paying for the bus?
o: She must use a ticket machine.
She can pay when she gets on.
qs.ex: 탈 때 휴대폰이나 카드를 단말기에 대면 된다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 표를 미리 사야 하냐는 질문에 No라고 했으므로 (C)는 오답.

script.t: Hi, Ruth. Are you going to any of the sessions at Digital Skills Day on Tuesday?
Definitely. I signed up for the one about AI assistants. Everyone on my team is starting to use them.
Actually, I just got an e-mail about that. The instructor can't come in the morning, so the session is going to switch times with the online security session.
Oh, that's fine. I'm free all afternoon anyway.
Me too. Let's go together, then. Should we have lunch first?
Sure. There's a new Thai restaurant across the street. I'll book a table for noon.

qs.q: What does the woman say about her team?
o: It is moving to a new office.
Its members are starting to use AI assistants.
qs.ex: 팀원 모두가 AI 비서를 쓰기 시작했다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 이사·채용 이야기는 나오지 않음.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What time will the AI assistants session now begin?
qs.ex: AI 세션이 Online Security 세션과 시간을 맞바꾼다고 했으므로 3시인 (D)가 정답. 원래 시간인 10:30(B)을 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What will the woman most likely do next?
qs.ex: 12시로 태국 식당 테이블을 예약하겠다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 이메일은 남자가 받은 것이므로 (A)는 함정.

parts.name: Part 4
parts.dir: 한 사람이 말하는 짧은 담화를 듣고, 화면에 제시된 담화별 질문 세 개에 대해 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 담화는 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않으며 한 번만 들려줍니다.

script.t: Hello, this is Patricia from Hillside Auto Service, calling for Mr. Tom Becker. I'm calling about the car you dropped off this morning for its regular check-up. Our mechanic found that two of your tires are quite worn, and we recommend replacing them for safety. The cost would be about two hundred and forty dollars, including installation. If you'd like us to go ahead, please reply to the text message we just sent you. Just type "yes." Otherwise, your car will be ready for pickup at five o'clock today as planned. Also, as a thank-you to our regular customers, we're offering a free car wash this month. Thanks, and talk to you soon.

qs.q: Where does the speaker most likely work?
qs.ex: 고객이 맡긴 차를 정기 점검하고 타이어 교체를 권하므로 자동차 정비소(C)가 정답. tires만 듣고 타이어 공장 (D)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker recommend?
qs.ex: 타이어 두 개가 많이 닳아 교체를 권한다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 세차는 무료 행사로 언급된 것이므로 (C)는 함정.

qs.q: What should the listener do if he agrees?
qs.ex: 진행을 원하면 방금 보낸 문자에 yes라고 답장하라고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 음성 메시지라 전화 회신 (A)를 고르기 쉬운 함정.

script.t: Attention, Greenway Market shoppers. Starting next Monday, we will no longer offer plastic bags at our checkout counters. This is part of our plan to reduce waste in our community. Shoppers can bring their own bags, or buy one of our reusable cloth bags for just one dollar. To help with the change, we'll be giving away free cloth bags this weekend to anyone who spends more than thirty dollars. Also, don't forget to download our new store app. You can use it to make shopping lists, find items in the store, and get special coupons every week. Thank you for shopping at Greenway Market.

qs.q: What will change next Monday?
o: A new checkout area will open.
Plastic bags will no longer be provided.
Prices of cloth bags will increase.
qs.ex: 다음 주 월요일부터 계산대에서 비닐봉지를 제공하지 않는다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. checkout counters가 들린다고 새 계산대 (A)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: How can shoppers get a free cloth bag?
o: By spending more than thirty dollars
qs.ex: 이번 주말 30달러 넘게 구매하면 천 가방을 무료로 준다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 앱은 쿠폰용으로 소개되었으므로 (B)는 함정.

qs.q: According to the speaker, what can shoppers do with the store app?
qs.ex: 앱으로 쇼핑 목록 작성, 상품 위치 찾기, 매주 쿠폰 받기가 가능하다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 결제·배달 기능은 언급되지 않음.

script.t: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Sunridge Chocolate Factory. My name is Mia, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will take about an hour. First, we'll see where the cocoa beans are roasted, and then we'll walk through the area where our chocolate bars are wrapped. Please stay with the group at all times, and remember that taking photos is not allowed inside the production areas. Now, I know what you're all waiting for. Yes, there will be samples! At the end of the tour, you'll be able to taste five of our most popular flavors in our gift shop. Everyone will also receive a discount coupon for anything you buy there today. OK, let's get started.

qs.q: What are the listeners asked not to do?
o: Leave their bags in the lobby
qs.ex: 생산 구역 안에서는 사진 촬영이 금지라고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 시식이 있다고 했으니 먹지 말라는 (D)는 오답.

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "I know what you're all waiting for"?
o: To ask the listeners to be patient
To introduce a part of the tour that visitors look forward to
To apologize for a long wait
To explain why the tour is starting late
qs.ex: 바로 뒤에 '네, 시식이 있습니다!'라고 하므로 방문객들이 기대하는 순서를 소개하려는 말인 (B)가 정답. waiting을 실제로 기다린 것으로 오해한 (C)·(D)는 함정.

qs.q: What will the listeners receive at the end of the tour?
qs.ex: 모두에게 기념품점 할인 쿠폰을 준다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 시식은 가게에서 맛보는 것이지 상자를 받는 것이 아니므로 (C)는 함정.

script.t: Do you love fresh coffee but never have time to go to the store? Try Bean Route, the coffee subscription service that delivers freshly roasted beans right to your door. Each month, you can choose from over thirty kinds of coffee from small farms around the world. Our beans are roasted the day before they're shipped, so they're always fresh. And our boxes are made from one hundred percent recycled materials. Plans start at just fifteen dollars a month, and you can skip or cancel a delivery anytime with one click. Sign up on our Web site this month and enter the code FRESH to get your first box free. Bean Route: great coffee, delivered.

qs.q: What is being advertised?
qs.ex: 원두를 집으로 배달해 주는 커피 구독 서비스 광고이므로 (C)가 정답. coffee만 듣고 카페 개업 (D)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker say about the boxes?
o: They can be returned for a refund.
They are made from recycled materials.
qs.ex: 상자가 100% 재활용 소재로 만들어졌다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 배송은 매달(Each month)이므로 매주 (B)는 오답.

qs.q: How can the listeners get their first box free?
qs.ex: 이번 달 웹사이트에서 가입하며 코드 FRESH를 입력하면 첫 상자가 무료라고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. small farms에서 연상한 (B)는 함정.

script.t: OK, let's begin today's meeting with some good news. Starting next week, our office will use a new AI scheduling assistant. When you need to set up a meeting, you just type who you want to meet and how long it will take. The assistant checks everyone's calendars and finds a time that works. No more sending ten e-mails back and forth. I tried it last week with the design team, and it found a time for eight people in under a minute. Eight people. The IT department will hold a short online training session on Monday at ten. It's only thirty minutes, so please make sure to attend. After that, you can start using it right away.

qs.q: What is the main topic of the meeting?
qs.ex: 다음 주부터 쓸 AI 일정 조율 도구를 소개하는 내용이므로 (C)가 정답. design team이 들린다고 디자인 프로젝트 (D)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "Eight people"?
o: To say that a team is too large
To emphasize how useful the tool is
To ask how many people will attend
To correct a number she gave
qs.ex: 여덟 명의 일정을 1분 안에 맞췄다는 사실을 한 번 더 강조해 도구가 얼마나 유용한지 보여 주는 말이므로 (B)가 정답. 숫자를 정정하는 (D)로 오해하기 쉬움.

qs.q: What are the listeners asked to do?
o: Send an e-mail to the IT department
qs.ex: 월요일 10시에 열리는 30분짜리 온라인 교육에 꼭 참석하라고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. IT 부서에 이메일을 보내라는 말은 없으므로 (C)는 오답.

script.t: You're listening to Radio Brookfield, and this is the local news. The city announced today that forty new electric vehicle charging stations will be installed downtown by the end of the year. The stations will be placed in public parking lots near the library, city hall, and the central market. According to Mayor Diane Ortiz, the number of electric cars in Brookfield has doubled over the past two years, and drivers have complained about long waits at the city's few chargers. Drivers will be able to find available chargers and pay through the city's parking app. Construction on the first stations begins next month. Now, let's check on the weather with Sam.

qs.q: What is the news report mainly about?
qs.ex: 시내에 전기차 충전소 40곳을 새로 설치한다는 뉴스이므로 (C)가 정답. library는 설치 장소로만 언급되었으므로 (B)는 함정.

qs.q: Why are the stations being installed?
o: Drivers have had to wait a long time to charge.
qs.ex: 전기차가 두 배로 늘어 운전자들이 충전 대기 시간이 길다고 불만을 제기했으므로 (A)가 정답. 법 규정 이야기는 없으므로 (C)는 오답.

qs.q: What will the listeners most likely hear next?
qs.ex: 마지막에 Sam과 날씨를 확인하자고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 시장 이름이 나왔다고 인터뷰 (D)를 고르면 함정.

script.t: Good afternoon, passengers. This is an announcement for the four fifteen train to Lakeport. Because of a signal problem near Carver Station, this train will depart about twenty-five minutes late. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please note that the train will now leave from Platform 6 instead of Platform 2. Passengers who need to make a connection in Lakeport should speak to a staff member at the information desk, who can change your ticket at no cost. While you wait, a free coffee or tea is available at the station café on the upper level. Simply show your ticket. If you booked through our mobile app, updates will also be sent to your phone.

qs.q: What has caused the delay?
qs.ex: Carver역 근처 신호 문제 때문에 지연된다고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 날씨 이야기는 없으므로 (B)는 오답.

qs.q: What has changed about the train?
qs.ex: 2번이 아니라 6번 승강장에서 출발한다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 목적지 Lakeport는 그대로이므로 (C)는 함정.

qs.q: What can passengers get at the station café?
qs.ex: 표를 보여 주면 커피나 차를 무료로 준다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 표 변경은 안내 데스크에서 하므로 (B)는 함정.

script.t: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I'd like to introduce our newest team member, Hana Lee. Hana is joining our customer support department as a team leader. She has eight years of experience, most recently at an online furniture company, where she helped set up its chat support service. As many of you know, our customers have been asking for faster replies, and we're planning to launch live chat on our Web site this spring. So, we couldn't have asked for better timing. Hana will work in the office on Mondays and Thursdays and from home the rest of the week. Please stop by and say hello. And Hana, after this meeting, Chris will give you a tour of the building.

qs.q: Who is Hana Lee?
qs.ex: 고객지원부 팀장으로 새로 합류한 직원이므로 (D)가 정답. 이전 직장이 가구 회사였다는 말만 듣고 (A)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker mean when he says, "we couldn't have asked for better timing"?
o: Hana's experience fits a project that is starting soon.
A project has been finished early.
Hana was hired more quickly than expected.
qs.ex: 곧 웹사이트 라이브 채팅을 시작하는데 Hana가 채팅 상담 구축 경험이 있으니 '시기가 딱 맞다'는 뜻이므로 (B)가 정답. timing을 회의 시작 시간으로 오해한 (A)는 함정.

qs.q: What will happen after the meeting?
o: The team will have lunch together.
Hana will be shown around the building.
A live chat service will be tested.
qs.ex: 회의 후 Chris가 Hana에게 건물을 안내해 준다고 했으므로 (C)가 정답. 라이브 채팅은 봄에 시작할 예정이라 (D)는 오답.

script.t: Thanks for coming, everyone. As you know, last month we asked all employees which new benefit they'd most like the company to offer. Here are the results. As you can see, the most popular answer by far was flexible working hours. Management is now discussing how to make that work, and we'll share a plan in May. However, the benefit in second place is something we can offer right away. We've already contacted the fitness center across the street, and they've agreed to give our staff a forty percent discount. Details will be posted on the company intranet this Friday. I'd also like to thank everyone who completed the survey. Over ninety percent of you responded.

qs.ex: 직원들이 원하는 새 복리후생을 묻는 설문이었으므로 (D)가 정답. 고객 설문으로 착각한 (C)는 오답.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What percentage of employees chose the benefit that will be offered right away?
qs.ex: 바로 제공할 수 있는 것은 2위 항목(헬스장 할인)이고 표에서 Gym membership은 25%이므로 (B)가 정답. 1위인 42%(A)는 아직 논의 중이라 함정.

qs.q: According to the speaker, what will happen on Friday?
o: A new survey will be sent.
qs.ex: 금요일에 사내 인트라넷에 세부 내용이 게시된다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답. 계획 발표는 5월이므로 (A)는 함정.

script.t: Hi, everyone. It's Victor from Human Resources with an update about our company picnic. As you know, it was planned for this Saturday at Willow Lake Park. Unfortunately, the forecast shows heavy rain all day Saturday, so we've decided to change the date. A few people suggested Friday, but it looks like it'll be rainy then, too. So we're moving the picnic to the one sunny day in the forecast. Everything else stays the same. We'll start at eleven, and lunch will be provided by a local barbecue restaurant. Finally, if you're planning to drive, please share rides when possible, because parking at the park is limited.

qs.q: Why has the picnic been rescheduled?
qs.ex: 토요일에 폭우가 예보되어 날짜를 바꾼다고 했으므로 (A)가 정답. 식당은 그대로 점심을 제공하므로 (B)는 오답.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. On which day will the picnic be held?
qs.ex: 예보에서 유일하게 맑은 날로 옮긴다고 했고 표에서 Sunny는 일요일이므로 (D)가 정답. 원래 날짜인 토요일(C)은 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
qs.ex: 주차 공간이 부족하니 가능하면 차를 같이 타라고 했으므로 (D)가 정답. 점심은 식당이 제공하므로 (C)는 오답.

parts.name: Part 5
parts.dir: 문장의 빈칸(-------)에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 단어나 구를 (A)~(D) 중에서 고르세요.

items.q: The sales manager prepared the presentation slides ------- because her assistant was on vacation.
items.ex: 주어(The sales manager)가 직접 했다는 뜻을 더하는 강조 용법의 재귀대명사 herself가 정답입니다. her는 목적격·소유격이라 문장 끝에 홀로 올 수 없습니다.

items.q: Visitors are asked to scan the QR code at the reception desk ------- they enter the building.
items.ex: 빈칸 뒤에 주어+동사(they enter)가 있으므로 접속사 as soon as가 와야 합니다. because of·despite는 전치사, in order to는 동사원형이 뒤따라야 하는 함정입니다.

items.q: The company's new electric delivery vans are much ------- than the old diesel trucks.
items.ex: 뒤에 than이 있고 much가 비교급을 강조하므로 비교급 quieter가 정답입니다. quietest는 최상급이라 than과 함께 쓰지 않습니다.

items.q: Hybrid workers can reserve a desk ------- the company's mobile app.
items.ex: '앱을 통해서' 예약한다는 수단의 의미이므로 through가 정답입니다. among은 셋 이상의 '사이에서'라는 뜻이라 수단을 나타내지 못합니다.

items.q: Mr. Tanaka ------- the quarterly sales report by the end of the day tomorrow.
items.ex: tomorrow라는 미래 시점 표현이 있으므로 미래 시제 will submit이 정답입니다. submitted·has submitted는 과거·현재완료라 tomorrow와 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: The new employee handbook clearly ------- the company's policy on remote work.
items.ex: 안내서가 재택근무 정책을 '설명한다'는 뜻이므로 explains가 정답입니다. expresses는 감정·의견을 '표현하다'라서 정책과는 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: Members of the premium plan are ------- to free shipping on all orders.
items.ex: be entitled to + 명사는 '~을 받을 자격이 있다'는 뜻으로 무료 배송 혜택과 어울립니다. capable은 of, aware는 of와 함께 쓰므로 to와 맞지 않습니다.

items.q: The conference room on the third floor ------- for the training session next week.
items.ex: 회의실은 예약을 '받는' 대상이므로 수동태 has been reserved가 정답입니다. reserves·is reserving은 능동태라 회의실이 무언가를 예약하는 이상한 뜻이 됩니다.

items.q: Please contact Ms. Rivera, ------- is in charge of the eco-packaging project.
items.ex: 선행사가 사람(Ms. Rivera)이고 빈칸 뒤에 동사 is가 바로 오므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 정답입니다. whom은 목적격이라 뒤에 주어가 있어야 합니다.

items.q: The new packaging is made from ------- materials that can be composted at home.
items.ex: 명사 materials를 꾸미는 자리이므로 형용사 natural이 정답입니다. naturally는 부사라 명사를 수식할 수 없습니다.

items.q: Because of the heavy rain, the outdoor product launch has been ------- until Friday.
items.ex: until Friday와 함께 '금요일로 연기되었다'는 뜻이 되는 postponed가 정답입니다. prevented는 '막다'라서 until과 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: Our online booking system allows patients to ------- their appointments at any time.
items.ex: allow + 목적어 + to부정사 구조이므로 to 뒤에는 동사원형 change가 와야 합니다. changing은 동명사라 to 뒤 동사원형 자리에 맞지 않습니다.

items.q: Ms. Lee will be working from home ------- the office is being renovated.
items.ex: 빈칸 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 오고 '~하는 동안'이라는 뜻이 필요하므로 접속사 while이 정답입니다. during은 같은 뜻이지만 전치사라 명사만 받습니다.

items.q: The AI scheduling assistant automatically sends a ------- to attendees one hour before each meeting.
items.ex: 관사 a 뒤, 동사 sends의 목적어 자리이므로 명사 reminder가 정답입니다. remind는 동사라 관사 뒤에 올 수 없습니다.

items.q: Applicants should submit their résumés ------- October 15.
items.ex: 제출처럼 한 번에 끝나는 동작의 '마감 기한'은 by로 나타냅니다. until은 상태가 계속될 때 쓰는 '~까지'라서 함정입니다.

items.q: The new charging stations in the parking garage are ------- to all employees free of charge.
items.ex: be available to + 사람은 '~가 이용할 수 있다'는 뜻으로 문맥에 맞습니다. responsible은 '책임이 있는'이라 충전소 설명에 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: Brightline Logistics plans to ------- 30 new drivers to support its growing electric vehicle fleet.
items.ex: 늘어나는 전기차 차량을 운영하려고 운전기사를 '채용한다'는 뜻의 hire가 정답입니다. retire는 '은퇴하다'로 목적어를 받지 않습니다.

items.q: The store manager ------- reads every online review that customers post.
items.ex: 주어와 동사(reads) 사이에서 동사를 꾸미는 자리이므로 부사 carefully가 정답입니다. careful은 형용사라 동사를 수식할 수 없습니다.

items.q: Due to increased demand, the café will ------- its business hours on weekends.
items.ex: 수요가 늘어 주말 영업시간을 '연장한다'는 뜻의 extend가 정답입니다. attract는 '끌어들이다'로 hours와 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: ------- the training session was long, most participants found it very useful.
items.ex: '길었지만 유용했다'는 양보 관계이고 뒤에 절이 오므로 접속사 Although가 정답입니다. Despite는 전치사, However는 부사라 두 절을 연결할 수 없습니다.

items.q: Employees must obtain ------- from their manager before working remotely on Fridays.
items.ex: 동사 obtain의 목적어 자리이므로 명사 approval이 정답입니다. approve는 동사원형이라 목적어 자리에 올 수 없습니다.

items.q: Thank you for your ------- order. Your package will be shipped within two business days.
items.ex: 곧 배송될 주문이므로 '최근의' 주문이라는 recent가 정답입니다. frequent는 '잦은'이라 단수 order 하나를 꾸미기에 어색합니다.

items.q: The orientation for new staff members ------- at 9 A.M. in the main lobby every Monday.
items.ex: 주어의 핵심은 단수 The orientation이고 every Monday는 반복되는 일이므로 현재 시제 단수 동사 begins가 정답입니다. 바로 앞 members에 끌려 begin을 고르면 틀립니다.

items.q: Ms. Chen's team ------- a survey of 500 customers to learn about their shopping habits.
items.ex: conduct a survey는 '설문조사를 실시하다'라는 대표 표현입니다. convinced는 '설득했다'라서 survey와 어울리지 않습니다.

items.q: Subscribers can cancel their membership at any time without paying an extra -------.
items.ex: 해지할 때 추가로 내는 '수수료'를 뜻하는 fee가 정답입니다. salary는 '급여'라서 고객이 내는 돈이 아닙니다.

items.q: The product samples ------- to the client yesterday afternoon.
items.ex: 샘플은 보내지는 대상이고 yesterday가 있으므로 과거 수동태 were sent가 정답입니다. sent만 쓰면 샘플이 무언가를 보낸 능동의 뜻이 됩니다.

items.q: The IT department will ------- the old computers with faster models next month.
items.ex: replace A with B는 'A를 B로 교체하다'라는 표현으로 with와 짝을 이룹니다. remove는 '치우다'라서 with faster models와 맞지 않습니다.

items.q: Please keep your receipt as ------- of purchase.
items.ex: proof of purchase는 '구매 증빙'이라는 고정 표현입니다. product는 '제품'이라 영수증을 설명할 수 없습니다.

items.q: The office supplies ------- we ordered last week have not arrived yet.
items.ex: 선행사가 사물(office supplies)이고 ordered의 목적어가 빠져 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 정답입니다. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 앞에 명사가 있으면 쓸 수 없습니다.

items.q: The bank's mobile app has received ------- reviews from users for its simple design.
items.ex: 단순한 디자인 덕분에 '긍정적인' 리뷰를 받았다는 뜻의 positive가 정답입니다. punctual은 '시간을 지키는'이라 리뷰를 꾸미지 않습니다.

parts.name: Part 6
parts.dir: 지문을 읽고 빈칸 [1]~[4]에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 단어·구·문장을 고르세요. 지문마다 알맞은 문장을 고르는 문항이 하나씩 있습니다.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: All Staff
From: Daniel Moreau, Operations Manager
Date: February 23
Subject: New meeting scheduler

Dear team,

Starting Monday, March 2, we will begin using Calendra, an AI-powered scheduling tool, to book all internal meetings. The tool checks everyone's calendar and [1] suggests a time that works for all attendees. [2]

To get started, please log in with your company e-mail address and connect your calendar. If you work from home on certain days, you can mark those days in your profile so that the tool [3] online meetings for you on those days.

A short training video is available on the company intranet. We encourage you to watch it [4] using the tool for the first time.

Best regards,
Daniel Moreau

qs.ex: 동사 suggests를 꾸미는 자리이므로 부사 automatically가 정답입니다. automatic은 형용사라 동사를 수식할 수 없습니다.

o: Please return your old laptops to the IT department.
Our sales increased by 10 percent last year.
This will save you the time of sending many e-mails back and forth.
The cafeteria will be closed for repairs next week.
qs.ex: 앞 문장의 '모두에게 맞는 시간을 자동으로 제안한다'는 장점을 This로 받아 '이메일을 주고받는 시간을 아껴 준다'고 이어 주는 문장이 자연스럽습니다. 노트북 반납·식당 공사는 일정 도구와 관계없는 내용입니다.
so that 뒤에서 앞으로 반복될 일반적인 기능을 말하므로 현재 시제 schedules가 정답입니다. had scheduled·was scheduling은 과거라 앞으로 쓸 도구 설명과 맞지 않습니다.
'처음 사용하기 전에 영상을 보라'는 뜻이므로 before가 정답입니다. unless(~하지 않으면)를 넣으면 뜻이 어색해집니다.

passages.title: Notice
passages.body:
Notice to Members
Harborview Community Center

Beginning April 1, Harborview Community Center will use a new QR code check-in system. Members will no longer need to show their plastic membership cards at the front desk. [1], they will scan a QR code on their phones at the entrance.

To receive your code, download the Harborview app and sign in with your member number. The code will appear on the app's main screen. [2]

Members who do not have a smartphone may [3] a printed QR card at the front desk at no cost.

We believe this change will make entry faster and more [4] for everyone. Thank you for your cooperation.

qs.ex: '카드를 보여 줄 필요가 없다 → 대신 QR을 스캔한다'는 대체 관계이므로 Instead가 정답입니다. For example은 앞 내용의 예시를 들 때 쓰므로 맞지 않습니다.

o: The parking lot will be repainted on Sunday.
Thank you for attending last month's meeting.
Our swimming pool is open until 9 P.M.
It is updated every day for security reasons.
qs.ex: 앞 문장의 The code를 It으로 받아 '보안을 위해 매일 바뀐다'고 설명하는 문장이 자연스럽습니다. 수영장 운영 시간·주차장 도색은 QR 코드 받는 방법과 무관합니다.
조동사 may 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 request가 정답입니다. requests는 3인칭 단수형이라 조동사 뒤에 올 수 없습니다.
make + 목적어(entry) + 형용사 구조에서 faster와 and로 나란히 이어지므로 형용사 convenient가 정답입니다. convenience는 명사라 faster와 형태가 맞지 않습니다.

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
PORTVILLE (May 12) — Swiftway Couriers announced on Tuesday that it will [1] all of its gasoline delivery vans with electric vehicles by the end of next year. The company currently operates 120 vans in the Portville area.

"Our customers care about the environment, and so do we," said CEO Marisa Delgado. "[2]"

To support the new vehicles, Swiftway is installing 40 charging stations at its main depot on Fulton Road. The stations are expected to be fully [3] by September.

Ms. Delgado added that the switch will also reduce the company's fuel costs. "Electric vans are cheaper to operate and maintain," she said. "[4], we can keep our delivery prices low."

qs.ex: replace A with B(A를 B로 교체하다) 구조로 '휘발유 밴을 전기차로 바꾼다'는 뜻이 됩니다. remind는 '상기시키다'라서 with electric vehicles와 어울리지 않습니다.

o: We are looking for experienced chefs for our new restaurant.
Switching to electric vans is an important step toward reducing our emissions.
Our office will be closed on national holidays.
Tickets for the event can be purchased online.
qs.ex: '우리도 환경을 생각한다'는 말 뒤에 전기 밴 전환이 배출가스 감축의 중요한 단계라는 문장이 자연스럽게 이어집니다. 요리사 채용·공휴일 휴무는 배송 회사의 전기차 전환과 관계없습니다.
be동사 be 뒤 보어 자리이고 부사 fully의 꾸밈을 받으므로 형용사 operational(가동 중인)이 정답입니다. operate는 동사원형이라 be 뒤에 올 수 없습니다.
'운영비가 싸다 → 그 결과 배송료를 낮게 유지한다'는 인과 관계이므로 As a result가 정답입니다. In contrast는 대조를 나타내 흐름과 반대입니다.

passages.title: Memo
passages.body:
MEMO
To: Customer Service Team
From: Grace Albright, Customer Service Manager
Date: June 8
Re: Responding to online reviews

As many of you know, more customers now read online reviews before they [1] a purchase. For this reason, we will start responding to every review posted on our Web site within 48 hours.

When you reply to a negative review, please apologize and offer to help. Do not argue with the customer. [2]

Each Friday, I will send a summary of the week's reviews to the team. This report will help us find common problems and [3] our service.

If you have any questions about the new policy, please talk to me or to [4] assistant manager, Kevin Ito.

qs.ex: make a purchase는 '구매하다'라는 고정 표현이므로 make가 정답입니다. take는 purchase와 짝을 이루지 않는 함정입니다.

o: Our new store will open in the Westfield Mall next month.
The training room is located on the second floor.
Instead, ask them to contact us directly so we can solve the problem.
Please submit your expense reports by Thursday.
qs.ex: '고객과 논쟁하지 말라' 다음에 Instead로 '대신 직접 연락하도록 요청하라'는 대안을 주는 문장이 자연스럽습니다. 신규 매장·경비 보고서는 리뷰 응대와 관계없는 내용입니다.
help us + 동사원형(find) and 동사원형 구조이므로 find와 나란히 쓰이는 improve가 정답입니다. improvement는 명사라 our service를 목적어로 받을 수 없습니다.
명사 assistant manager 앞에서 '나의'라는 뜻을 나타내는 소유격 my가 정답입니다. mine은 소유대명사라 뒤에 명사를 둘 수 없습니다.

parts.name: Part 7
parts.dir: 지문을 읽고 각 질문에 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 단일 지문 10개, 이중 지문 2세트, 삼중 지문 3세트 순서입니다.

passages.title: Text-message chain
passages.body:
Jenna Kowalski (9:12 A.M.)
Hi Marcus. I'm at the Danforth office for the client meeting, but the receptionist says the visitor parking lot is full.

Marcus Lin (9:14 A.M.)
There's a public garage on Elm Street, just one block north. The company will cover the fee.

Jenna Kowalski (9:15 A.M.)
Great. Do I need to keep the receipt?

Marcus Lin (9:16 A.M.)
Yes, please. Just upload a photo of it to the expense app.

Jenna Kowalski (9:17 A.M.)
Will do. The meeting starts at 9:30, so I should still make it on time.

qs.q: What problem does Ms. Kowalski have?
o: She is late for a flight.
She cannot find a place to park.
qs.ex: 9시 12분 메시지에서 방문객 주차장이 꽉 찼다고 했으므로 주차할 곳이 없는 것이 문제입니다. receipt는 대화에 나오지만 잃어버렸다는 말은 없습니다.

qs.q: At 9:17 A.M., what does Ms. Kowalski mean when she writes, "Will do"?
o: She will upload an image of a receipt.
She will move her car later.
qs.ex: 바로 앞에서 Mr. Lin이 영수증 사진을 경비 앱에 올리라고 했고, "Will do"는 '그렇게 하겠다'는 수락의 뜻입니다. 회의는 제시간에 간다고 했으므로 취소는 오답입니다.

passages.title: Advertisement
passages.body:
FreshCrate — Healthy Meals Delivered Weekly

Choose from more than 30 recipes every week. Each box contains fresh ingredients and easy step-by-step instructions.

• Plans start at $49 per week for two people
• Skip a week or cancel anytime through the FreshCrate app
• All boxes are packed in 100% compostable materials

New subscribers: Enter the code START20 at checkout to get 20% off your first two boxes. Offer ends June 30.

qs.q: What is mentioned about FreshCrate's packaging?
o: It can be returned for a refund.
It is available in several colors.
qs.ex: 광고에 모든 상자가 100% 퇴비화 가능한(compostable) 재료로 포장된다고 나옵니다. 반품·추가 요금에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

qs.q: How can new subscribers receive a discount?
o: By recommending the service to a friend
By entering a code when ordering
qs.ex: 신규 가입자는 결제할 때 START20 코드를 입력하면 20% 할인을 받습니다. 마감은 6월 30일이므로 5월 1일은 근거 없는 함정입니다.

passages.title: Notice
passages.body:
Westgate Business Park — EV Charging Rules

The electric vehicle charging stations in Parking Area B are available to all tenants and their employees.

1. Charging is free, but each vehicle may use a station for a maximum of three hours per day.
2. Please move your vehicle as soon as charging is complete so that others can use the station.
3. Stations must be reserved in advance through the Westgate Tenant Portal.
4. Report any broken equipment to the management office at extension 210.

Vehicles that remain at a station for more than three hours may receive a warning notice.

qs.q: Where are the charging stations located?
o: On the roof of the building
qs.ex: 첫 문장에 충전소가 Parking Area B에 있다고 나옵니다. 관리사무소는 고장 신고처로만 언급됩니다.

qs.q: What are drivers required to do?
qs.ex: 3번 규칙에 충전소는 Tenant Portal에서 미리 예약해야 한다고 했습니다. 1번 규칙에서 충전은 무료라고 했으므로 요금을 낸다는 보기는 오답입니다.

passages.title: Online chat
passages.body:
Leah Novak [2:03 P.M.]
Hi, I'm trying to download my monthly invoice from the StreamDesk account page, but the button isn't working.

Ravi (Support Agent) [2:04 P.M.]
I'm sorry about that. Our team is updating the billing page this afternoon. I can e-mail you a copy of the invoice instead.

Leah Novak [2:05 P.M.]
That works. Please send it to the address on my account.

Ravi (Support Agent) [2:06 P.M.]
Done. You should receive it within a few minutes.

Leah Novak [2:07 P.M.]
Got it. Thanks for your help!

qs.q: Why did Ms. Novak contact the company?
o: She was unable to download a document.
She wanted to cancel her subscription.
qs.ex: 첫 메시지에서 월 청구서(invoice)를 내려받으려는데 버튼이 작동하지 않는다고 했습니다. 구독 해지나 이중 결제 이야기는 없습니다.

qs.q: At 2:05 P.M., what does Ms. Novak mean when she writes, "That works"?
o: She has found the download button.
qs.ex: 상담원이 청구서를 이메일로 보내 주겠다고 제안하자 "That works"(그거 좋네요)라고 수락한 것입니다. work라는 단어 때문에 '컴퓨터가 다시 작동한다'를 고르면 함정에 빠집니다.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: All Employees
From: Hannah Brooks, Human Resources Director
Date: August 3
Subject: Updated hybrid work schedule

Dear colleagues,

Thank you for sharing your opinions in last month's survey about our hybrid work arrangement. Based on your feedback, we are making a few changes starting September 1.

First, all employees will be expected to work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. These are the days when most team meetings take place. On the other days, you may choose to work from home or in the office.

Second, we are adding 20 bookable desks on the fourth floor. Employees can reserve a desk up to one week in advance using the DeskFinder app.

Finally, the company will continue to provide a monthly allowance of $40 for home Internet costs.

If you have any questions, please contact the HR team.

Hannah Brooks

qs.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
o: To ask employees to complete a survey
To introduce a new HR director
To announce changes to a work policy
To invite employees to a team meeting
qs.ex: 설문 결과를 바탕으로 9월 1일부터 하이브리드 근무 방식을 바꾼다고 알리는 이메일입니다. 설문은 지난달에 이미 끝났으므로 설문 참여 요청은 오답입니다.

qs.q: Why were Tuesdays and Thursdays chosen as office days?
o: The office is less crowded on those days.
Managers work from home on other days.
The Internet is faster in the office.
Most team meetings are held on those days.
qs.ex: 두 번째 문단에서 화·목요일은 대부분의 팀 회의가 열리는 날이라고 이유를 밝힙니다. 사무실 혼잡도는 언급되지 않습니다.

qs.q: What is indicated about the bookable desks?
o: They can be reserved up to a week ahead.
They are located on the first floor.
qs.ex: DeskFinder 앱으로 최대 일주일 전까지 예약할 수 있다고 했습니다. $40는 책상이 아니라 재택 인터넷 지원금이므로 함정입니다.

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
Online Reviews Help Local Shops Grow

GREENFIELD (October 4) — Small businesses in Greenfield are paying more attention to online reviews than ever before. [1] A recent survey by the Greenfield Business Association found that 82 percent of local shoppers read reviews before visiting a new store. [2]

Tomas Reyes, owner of Reyes Hardware, began asking customers to leave reviews last year. "We put a small sign with a QR code next to the cash register," he explained. "Customers scan it and write a few sentences on their phones." Since then, the number of reviews for his store has tripled. [3]

The association will hold a free workshop on managing online reviews on October 20 at the Greenfield Public Library. [4]

qs.q: What did the survey find?
o: Most local shoppers read reviews before going to a new store.
Fewer people are shopping at local stores.
Shoppers prefer to pay with their phones.
Most shops in Greenfield have their own Web sites.
qs.ex: 설문에서 지역 쇼핑객의 82%가 새 가게를 방문하기 전에 리뷰를 읽는다고 나왔습니다. 휴대폰 결제는 QR 코드 때문에 떠올리기 쉬운 함정입니다.

qs.q: How does Mr. Reyes collect reviews?
o: By displaying a QR code near the register
By calling customers after a purchase
qs.ex: 계산대 옆에 QR 코드 안내판을 두어 고객이 휴대폰으로 리뷰를 쓰게 했습니다. 할인 제공은 지문에 없습니다.

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Many of them also say that they trust reviews as much as advice from friends."
qs.ex: 삽입 문장의 them은 '지역 쇼핑객'을 가리키므로 쇼핑객 설문 결과 바로 뒤인 [2]가 알맞습니다. [1]에 넣으면 them이 '소상공인'을 가리키게 되어 어색합니다.

passages.title: Order confirmation

passages.title: Job posting
passages.body:
Fleet Coordinator — Brightline Logistics

Brightline Logistics is hiring a Fleet Coordinator for our Riverton distribution center. Brightline delivers packages for more than 200 online retailers and is replacing its delivery trucks with electric vehicles over the next three years.

Responsibilities:
• Plan daily delivery routes using our AI route-planning software
• Schedule vehicle charging and regular maintenance
• Work with drivers to solve problems on the road

Requirements:
• At least two years of experience in logistics or transportation
• Strong communication skills
• Experience with electric vehicles is preferred but not required

This is a full-time position. Employees may work from home one day per week after completing a three-month training period. To apply, send a résumé and cover letter to jobs@brightline-logistics.com by July 15. Interviews will be held in late July.

qs.q: What is indicated about Brightline Logistics?
o: It is opening a new distribution center.
It sells products on its own Web site.
It is changing to electric vehicles.
qs.ex: 첫 문단에서 앞으로 3년간 배송 트럭을 전기차로 교체한다고 했습니다. 200은 직원 수가 아니라 거래하는 온라인 판매업체 수입니다.

qs.q: What is one responsibility of the position?
qs.ex: 업무 첫 항목이 AI 경로 계획 소프트웨어로 매일 배송 경로를 짜는 일입니다. 정비는 직접 수리가 아니라 '일정을 잡는' 일이므로 수리는 오답입니다.

qs.q: The word "preferred" in the Requirements section is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: preferred but not required는 '있으면 좋지만 필수는 아니다'라는 뜻이므로 desired(바라는)와 가장 가깝습니다. required는 바로 뒤의 not required와 반대되는 함정입니다.

qs.q: When can a new employee work from home?
qs.ex: 3개월 교육 기간을 마친 뒤 주 1일 재택근무가 가능하다고 했습니다. late July는 면접 시기라 함정입니다.

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
Hotel Chain Adds AI Assistant

SEAVIEW CITY (March 3) — Dalton Hotels announced this week that guests at all 14 of its locations can now use an AI assistant to make requests during their stay. [1] Through the hotel's app, guests can order room service, ask for extra towels, or book a table at the hotel restaurant at any hour.

"Our guests told us they wanted faster service," said Olivia Grant, Dalton's vice president of guest services. "Now they can simply type a message and get an answer within seconds." [2]

The assistant can respond in eight languages. It also remembers guests' preferences, such as their favorite type of pillow, so that their next stay is even more comfortable. [3]

Ms. Grant stressed that the assistant will not replace hotel staff. "Our front desk team is still available 24 hours a day," she said. [4] According to Ms. Grant, the assistant handles small requests so that employees have more time to help guests in person.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: A plan to hire more hotel staff
A new service for hotel guests
The renovation of a hotel restaurant
qs.ex: 호텔 투숙객이 앱의 AI 비서로 요청을 할 수 있게 된 새 서비스에 관한 기사입니다. 14개 지점은 기존 지점 수이지 새로 연 호텔이 아닙니다.

qs.q: According to Ms. Grant, why did Dalton Hotels introduce the assistant?
o: Other hotels had already done so.
qs.ex: Ms. Grant는 고객들이 더 빠른 서비스를 원했다고 말했습니다. 직원이 도움을 요청했다는 내용은 없습니다.

qs.q: What is mentioned about the AI assistant?
o: It can communicate in several languages.
It replaces the front desk at night.
It is available only at one hotel.
It charges a fee for each request.
qs.ex: 세 번째 문단에 AI 비서가 8개 언어로 응답할 수 있다고 나옵니다. 프런트 데스크는 24시간 운영된다고 했으므로 대체한다는 보기는 오답입니다.

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This means that guests who do not wish to use the app can still call for help at any time."
qs.ex: 프런트 데스크가 24시간 운영된다는 말 바로 뒤인 [4]에 넣어야 This가 '프런트가 24시간 운영된다'는 사실을 받아 '앱을 원치 않는 고객도 언제든 도움을 요청할 수 있다'로 이어집니다. [1]은 앱 기능을 소개하기도 전이라 흐름이 어색합니다.

passages.title: Web page
passages.body:
Riverside Coworking — Membership Plans

Whether you work from home most days or need a desk every day, Riverside Coworking has a plan for you. All members enjoy high-speed Internet, free coffee and tea, and access to our rooftop garden.

Flex Plan — $120/month
Use any open desk up to 8 days per month.

Regular Plan — $250/month

o: People looking for a place to work

qs.q: What is included in all membership plans?
qs.ex: 모든 회원이 고속 인터넷, 무료 커피와 차, 옥상 정원을 이용한다고 했습니다. 회의실 이용은 Flex Plan에 없으므로 '모든' 플랜 공통이 아닙니다.

qs.q: Which plan would be best for a team of three people who sometimes work on weekends?
qs.ex: 최대 3명이 쓸 수 있고 주 7일 24시간 이용 가능한 것은 Private Office Plan입니다. Regular Plan은 월~금만 이용할 수 있어 주말 근무에 맞지 않습니다.

qs.q: What is offered to people who sign up before September 30?
o: A 50 percent discount on the first month
Free use of a meeting room
An extra day of desk use
qs.ex: 9월 30일 전에 가입하면 첫 달을 반값(half price)에 이용할 수 있습니다. 회의실은 비회원 대여 요금만 언급되었습니다.

passages.title: Web page
passages.body:
Mapleton Bike Share — Now with Electric Bikes!

Getting around Mapleton is easier than ever. Our 600 bikes, including 150 new electric bikes (e-bikes), are available at 80 stations across the city.

How to ride: Open the Mapleton Bike Share app and scan the QR code on the bike's handlebars to unlock it.

Ride options
• Pay Per Ride: $1 to unlock + $0.25 per minute (all bikes)
• Monthly Pass ($25): Unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes on standard bikes. E-bikes cost an extra $0.10 per minute.

To explain how to use a bike-sharing service
qs.ex: 자전거 공유 서비스의 이용 방법과 요금 옵션을 안내하는 웹페이지입니다. 자전거 판매점이나 경주 대회는 언급되지 않습니다.

qs.q: How do riders unlock a bike?
o: By scanning a code with a phone app
By entering a password at a station
qs.ex: 앱을 열어 핸들의 QR 코드를 스캔하면 잠금이 풀린다고 했습니다. 멤버십 카드를 보여 준다는 내용은 없습니다.

qs.q: Why was Ms. Turner charged $3.00?
o: Her pass does not include e-bikes at no extra cost.
She rode for more than 45 minutes.
She used the Pay Per Ride option.
She forgot to return the bike to a station.
qs.ex: [연계] 이메일에서 Monthly Pass로 e-bike를 30분 탔다고 했고, 웹페이지에 Monthly Pass는 e-bike에 분당 $0.10이 추가된다고 나옵니다(30분×$0.10=$3). 30분은 45분 이내이므로 시간 초과는 함정입니다.

qs.q: What problem does Ms. Turner report?
o: A station had no bikes available.
The app would not open on her phone.
A code on a bike could not be scanned.
qs.ex: 이메일 두 번째 문단에서 4471번 자전거의 QR 코드가 손상되어 스캔할 수 없었다고 했습니다. 배터리 문제는 언급되지 않습니다.

qs.q: How much does the pass Ms. Turner is considering cost?
qs.ex: [연계] 이메일에서 '연간 패스(yearly pass)'로 바꾸려 한다고 했고, 웹페이지에서 Annual Pass는 $180입니다. 150은 e-bike 대수라서 함정입니다.

passages.title: Memo
passages.body:

All employees who submit expense reports must attend one training session.

Session A — Tuesday, February 17, 10:00–11:00 A.M., Room 301 (in person)

Session C — Friday, February 20, 9:00–10:00 A.M., Room 301 (in person)

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:

qs.q: What does the memo say about ExpensePro?

qs.q: Which session did Ms. Vance originally sign up for?

qs.q: Which session will Ms. Vance most likely attend?
qs.ex: [연계] 수요일에도 출장이라 '다음 주 온라인 세션'으로 옮기고 싶다고 했으므로 2월 24일 온라인 Session D입니다. Session B도 온라인이지만 그녀가 출장 가는 수요일입니다.

qs.q: What does Ms. Vance ask Mr. Mercer about?
o: Whether Room 301 can hold more people
Whether she can visit a client in March
Whether a recording of the training will be available
Whether the sign-up deadline can be extended
qs.ex: 휴가 중인 동료 때문에 교육이 녹화되는지 물었습니다. 신청 마감 연장은 묻지 않았습니다.

qs.q: Why does Ms. Bishop need the boxes by November 25?

qs.q: How much did Ms. Bishop originally plan to spend on bubble wrap?

qs.q: What does Mr. Cho offer to do?

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Bishop's custom boxes?

Review by Tom Whitaker ★★★☆☆
Posted August 14

I rented a car from Voltara for a three-day family trip to the mountains. The car was clean and had enough room for all seven of us, and the QR check-in took less than a minute.

However, when I returned the car, I was charged a fee even though the battery was at 25%. I hope the company looks into this.
